lessons.learningObjective: Connect the first three known meanings to print in both directions.
lessons.recommendation: Keep the new Look-Build-Read-Recall routine; confirm the pictures are understood before interpreting a reading error.
lessons.teachingStep: Model each existing target and its two source forms, then fade the printed answer.
lessons.independentCheck: Read from print and enter from meaning in separate short attempts; retain the existing recognition gate.
lessons.correction: Reveal the exact target word and compare the source forms left to right; make the retry supported.
lessons.review: Later reading and entry on the same three IDs, separately from recognition.

lessons.learningObjective: Check the first word relationships without overclaiming written competence.
lessons.recommendation: Keep the recognition check; add a clearly separate optional written-recall observation, not retroactive completion credit.
lessons.teachingStep: Offer a model refresher before the check, recording that support.
lessons.independentCheck: Fresh picture-to-word check; any entry result receives its own task label.
lessons.correction: Show the selected and target association and offer retry with the model.
lessons.review: Return the least secure of these three targets through another skill on a later visit.

lessons.learningObjective: Read and reconstruct the two new source targets after a familiar anchor.
lessons.recommendation: Use the older anchor only when due; avoid repeating it as a fixed warm-up every time.
lessons.teachingStep: Demonstrate new word-picture relationships, construction and the reading direction.
lessons.independentCheck: Model-hidden reading then picture-cued entry for the two new IDs.
lessons.correction: Identify the first differing source-form position in text; do not invent a sound rule.
lessons.review: Review a new target plus one actually due older item within the existing budget.

lessons.learningObjective: Notice source-form reuse across familiar and new words.
lessons.recommendation: Let the learner locate an identical taught form across source words where present; equality is visual, not a pronunciation claim.
lessons.teachingStep: Show complete source words first, then highlight the actual matching codepoint/form.
lessons.independentCheck: Reconstruct a newly taught word without a complete-word model; record any revealing keys.
lessons.correction: Restore the two complete models and the shared visible form before retry.
lessons.review: Later whole-word reading and entry; do not score shared-form tapping as whole-word recall.

lessons.learningObjective: Read familiar meanings while keeping vocabulary knowledge separate from print.
lessons.recommendation: Check the picture/sense association for each new target before a print task; extra meaning support is permitted.
lessons.teachingStep: Introduce the existing sourced meaning and form model with a reviewed association.
lessons.independentCheck: Read one target from print and recall another from meaning after an intervening task.
lessons.correction: If the picture is unclear, explain the reviewed association and retry a supported task.
lessons.review: Keep meaning uncertainty distinct from a later failed print response.

lessons.learningObjective: Retrieve the final table-group word forms with reduced model support.
lessons.recommendation: Retain two new targets and bounded review; avoid a long all-group drill at the end.
lessons.teachingStep: Model and build before reading and recall; pause is always available.
lessons.independentCheck: Separate word-to-meaning and meaning-to-text attempts without the answer visible.
lessons.correction: Reveal only the relevant source model and offer another supported attempt.
lessons.review: Distribute the table-group targets across later visits rather than repeat all immediately.

lessons.learningObjective: Sample table-group reading and recall honestly.
lessons.recommendation: Current focus contains three words, not every table-group target; do not call this complete group mastery.
lessons.teachingStep: Offer an optional refresher using exactly the current focus; support is recorded.
lessons.independentCheck: Keep the current gate; propose a bounded future coverage queue for all introduced group targets by skill.
lessons.correction: Correct the actual missed association before continuing; never add an unseen answer key.
lessons.review: Cover unobserved introduced targets over later reviews, without increasing the per-session budget.

lessons.learningObjective: Connect new home-group print forms to familiar meanings.
lessons.recommendation: Keep Look-Build-Read-Recall; a real-world label activity needs reviewed contextual assets before release.
lessons.teachingStep: Model the actual candidate sense and picture, then its source-form order.
lessons.independentCheck: Identify meaning from print before picture-cued entry.
lessons.correction: Return the target word-picture model, then invite retry.
lessons.review: Later review in another approved depiction only after its association is reviewed.

lessons.learningObjective: Read household-group labels without relying on answer position.
lessons.recommendation: Vary answer positions between tasks and retain stable form-key layout within correction.
lessons.teachingStep: Demonstrate a complete source target before learners assemble it.
lessons.independentCheck: Read and enter each new word with full-word model hidden.
lessons.correction: Show the entered sequence beside the source model; locate the first mismatch or missing form.
lessons.review: Revisit by reading and entry; do not infer label use in a sentence.

lessons.learningObjective: Retrieve a single new target across visits.
lessons.recommendation: This lesson introduces only one new word, so avoid claiming within-lesson interleaving is equivalent to spaced review.
lessons.teachingStep: Show and construct the target, then use another eligible item if one is due.
lessons.independentCheck: One model-hidden reading and one cued entry attempt, with support labeled.
lessons.correction: Restore the complete target and give a supported retry without inflating independent success.
lessons.review: Prioritize a later-visit retrieval opportunity; do not generate extra filler to simulate spacing.

lessons.learningObjective: Check sampled home-group associations and find coverage gaps.
lessons.recommendation: Preserve the three current focus IDs; label the check as a sample and track other introduced targets separately.
lessons.teachingStep: Optional model recap without converting it into independent evidence.
lessons.independentCheck: Recognition gate remains; a future reading/entry sample uses only taught IDs.
lessons.correction: Specific source association and retry for the failed target.
lessons.review: Use a bounded queue to revisit group targets omitted by the sample.

lessons.learningObjective: Interpret the first outside-group source words from print.
lessons.recommendation: Keep the familiar anchor separate from two new targets; do not turn chapter naming into a cultural claim.
lessons.teachingStep: Introduce reviewed meaning/picture links, then source forms and complete words.
lessons.independentCheck: Reverse reading and picture-cued entry after model fading.
lessons.correction: Compare the actual source word to the response and allow a supported retry.
lessons.review: Revisit new words in a later eligible task; scenery alone supplies no extra evidence.

lessons.learningObjective: Relate a source family form across words without guessing sound.
lessons.recommendation: Reference only actual source family/order records; prepare a reviewer-approved sound comparison as a blocked extension.
lessons.teachingStep: Show the whole words before the relevant family relationship.
lessons.independentCheck: Locate the sourced target, then retrieve its complete taught word from meaning.
lessons.correction: Reopen the family reference and exact word model; keep pronunciation unassessed.
lessons.review: Schedule whole-word reading separately from locating a family form.

lessons.learningObjective: Recognize and retrieve two new source word meanings.
lessons.recommendation: Prevent picture-only success from standing in for reading; remove meaning cues before the print response.
lessons.teachingStep: Model existing meanings and source forms with reviewed visuals.
lessons.independentCheck: Read one word to meaning, then enter a different taught target from meaning.
lessons.correction: Demonstrate the correct link before the supported retry.
lessons.review: Later parallel visual depiction requires its own review; otherwise reuse the existing reviewed association.

lessons.learningObjective: Recall forms in the correct source order across new words.
lessons.recommendation: Use the actual two-form sequences; a puzzle edit must remain clearly synthetic task material, not a new word.
lessons.teachingStep: Build each complete approved target before a model-hidden entry attempt.
lessons.independentCheck: Enter a taught word without a visible answer, with native input or disclosed form-key support.
lessons.correction: Show the existing source target, mark a positional mismatch and retry; do not pronounce puzzle strings.
lessons.review: Return entry and reading separately in the existing scheduler.

lessons.learningObjective: Remember a single new word without excessive immediate repetition.
lessons.recommendation: As in u2-10, there is one new target; prefer a genuine later revisit to more same-screen repetitions.
lessons.teachingStep: Introduce, build, read and recall, offering a natural stop.
lessons.independentCheck: One independent attempt under recorded conditions, followed by ordinary recap.
lessons.correction: Return the source model and permit a supported retry or pause.
lessons.review: Later-visit recall is the key next observation; no same-day mastery label.

lessons.learningObjective: Check an outside-group sample and organize later coverage.
lessons.recommendation: Current three-word focus omits other introduced outside targets; keep the gate narrow and plan distributed coverage.
lessons.teachingStep: Optional recap of missed models before restarting a check.
lessons.independentCheck: Recognition now; future mixed reading/entry sample only on previously taught targets.
lessons.correction: Reveal the actual missed source association and offer retry without shame.
lessons.review: Rotate unobserved introduced outside targets through future bounded sessions.

lessons.learningObjective: Map people/body-group source meanings to print.
lessons.recommendation: Prioritize review of visual sense clarity and child suitability; do not infer meaning from an unfamiliar illustration.
lessons.teachingStep: Establish the candidate sense through its reviewed association before showing source forms.
lessons.independentCheck: Read and then retrieve new target words with model fading.
lessons.correction: If meaning is uncertain, teach it again and record support instead of calling it a reading failure.
lessons.review: Keep later meaning, reading and entry observations distinguishable.

lessons.learningObjective: Read familiar people-related concepts without identity assumptions.
lessons.recommendation: Use only current source senses; do not prescribe a household structure or family-role convention.
lessons.teachingStep: Show reviewed association and full target, then two-form construction.
lessons.independentCheck: Model-hidden word-to-meaning and picture-cued entry.
lessons.correction: Use the exact approved source association and permit help or skip to another target.
lessons.review: Later reuse needs a reviewed context, not an invented personal family sentence.

lessons.learningObjective: Connect the final two new source candidates to reading and recall.
lessons.recommendation: Review potentially abstract associations for clarity; dictionary inclusion alone does not establish a child-friendly picture.
lessons.teachingStep: Teach the existing source sense with a reviewer-approved model before removing cues.
lessons.independentCheck: Read then enter each new target without answer-revealing help, recorded by skill.
lessons.correction: Reintroduce the correct meaning/form model before another attempt.
lessons.review: Later review should include earlier new targets, not just the last two in the chapter.

lessons.learningObjective: Consolidate the sampled word relationships before Unit 3.
lessons.recommendation: Current three-word sample is not evidence for all 31 words; expose the evidence gap in the recap.
lessons.teachingStep: Optional refresher of actual focus targets; no new vocabulary.
lessons.independentCheck: Preserve recognition unlock; maintain separate reading and entry observations over subsequent visits.
lessons.correction: Give the source model for the specific miss and allow a fresh supported run.
lessons.review: Continue the distributed target/skill coverage queue without forcing one 31-word exam.

lessons.learningObjective: Locate first and last Fidäl forms inside taught words.
lessons.recommendation: Connect positional recognition to rebuilding the complete familiar word, not just tapping a highlighted answer.
lessons.teachingStep: Show source order left to right, then cover the target position during a practice example.
lessons.independentCheck: Locate a requested form without its highlight, then reconstruct the already taught word.
lessons.correction: Show complete source word and highlight the requested position before retry.
lessons.review: Review locating separately from complete-word entry and reading.

lessons.learningObjective: Use sourced family relationships in actual taught words.
lessons.recommendation: Preserve the current family and word set; expand examples only after their sources and teaching purpose are reviewed.
lessons.teachingStep: Model related source forms in whole words; reviewed sound comparison remains a gated extension.
lessons.independentCheck: Locate the family form and then read the complete word to meaning.
lessons.correction: Restore the family/whole-word reference and show the actual matching target.
lessons.review: Return both form-location and word-reading tasks after a delay.

lessons.learningObjective: Distinguish copying from independent word production.
lessons.recommendation: Add a copy-beside-model stage to a future verified writing adapter; keep text input and handwriting records separate.
lessons.teachingStep: Current source model/text copying remains; teacher strokes wait for verified provenance and approval.
lessons.independentCheck: After copying, optionally hide the model for a separate cued-entry attempt.
lessons.correction: Compare with exact source word; replay only the learner marks unless a teacher sequence is approved.
lessons.review: Later text entry is available; delayed handwriting judgment needs a qualified rubric.

lessons.learningObjective: Read familiar print without a picture cue supplying the answer.
lessons.recommendation: Use changed reviewed depictions for transfer only when available; do not randomize into unreviewed art.
lessons.teachingStep: Demonstrate full word meaning before the reading task.
lessons.independentCheck: Written word to meaning with the picture/model cue removed; no speech requirement.
lessons.correction: Reveal the matching source picture and word, then retry after another item.
lessons.review: A later parallel reading task is stronger evidence than repeated same-layout tapping.

lessons.learningObjective: Recall a taught word from meaning without its printed model.
lessons.recommendation: Make independent text recall explicit; offer memory handwriting as a separately gated, non-scored extension.
lessons.teachingStep: Brief supported copy first when needed, then hide the answer and accept actual Ethiopic input.
lessons.independentCheck: Picture-cued entry before reveal, support and input method recorded.
lessons.correction: Compare first differing source form or missing position, provide the target model and retry.
lessons.review: Return memory entry on a later visit; optional paper sample requires human review.

lessons.learningObjective: Combine familiar reading and text recall while preserving skill evidence.
lessons.recommendation: Broaden future cumulative coverage beyond the present three targets over several visits, not one long test.
lessons.teachingStep: Optional separate refreshers for reading and entry.
lessons.independentCheck: Mixed reading and entry with each result attributed to its own target/skill; no combined fluency score.
lessons.correction: Use the correction belonging to the failed mode, then a bounded retry.
lessons.review: Carry the distributed review queue forward; listening/speaking stay unassessed.

lessons.learningObjective: Understand approved familiar words before seeing text.
lessons.recommendation: Build the listening-first bridge only after native audio, directions and reviewed answer associations are available.
lessons.teachingStep: Approved native audio and meaning model, then a supported example.
lessons.independentCheck: Audio-first meaning choice without transcript; reveal print only after the response.
lessons.correction: Replay and show the approved match; a text-revealed retry is supported, not independent listening.
lessons.review: Later listening separate from reading; failed or missing audio cannot count as a language error.

lessons.learningObjective: Try a familiar spoken response with safe, honest feedback.
lessons.recommendation: Use voluntary rehearsal and optional local replay; no automatic pronunciation percentage or forced microphone.
lessons.teachingStep: Approved whole-word model and reviewer-authored articulation guidance where supported.
lessons.independentCheck: Optional spoken attempt under a qualified human rubric; self-report is not phonetic accuracy.
lessons.correction: Replay the correct model and one rubric-backed cue; offer another try, silent practice or stop.
lessons.review: Later voluntary rehearsal and human-scored parallel task only when the rubric is approved.

lessons.learningObjective: Interpret a short purposeful message using taught language.
lessons.recommendation: Keep blocked until a native author supplies the actual message, sense, syntax, media and accepted answers.
lessons.teachingStep: Work through one reviewed message in context, including unfamiliar language before testing.
lessons.independentCheck: Interpret a parallel approved message with one changed detail.
lessons.correction: Return the approved message model and explain the intended meaning before retry.
lessons.review: Later message comprehension plus known-word review; no sentence assembled from dictionary fragments.

lessons.learningObjective: Choose or produce a meaningful short reply.
lessons.recommendation: Keep blocked until a native-reviewed exchange and acceptable response variants exist.
lessons.teachingStep: Model intent and an appropriate reply, then rehearse a supported exchange.
lessons.independentCheck: Respond to a parallel approved prompt; selection, text production and spoken production receive different labels.
lessons.correction: Explain why the approved reply fits the situation; accept reviewed alternatives and allow retry.
lessons.review: Revisit the exchange in a later approved context; maintain separate reading/listening/production evidence.
